docs.title: Recommended article structure
docs.text:
1. Goal: Explain what the user will complete.
  2. Before you start: Mention permissions, connected accounts, and required data.
  3. Steps: Use short numbered actions with screenshots after important clicks.
  4. Video: Embed YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, or portal demo links where helpful.
  5. Troubleshooting: List common errors and fixes at the bottom.

docs.title: Plan and review an advertisement campaign
docs.text: Create campaign notes, attach creatives, define budget, and monitor campaign performance.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Open Advertisements.
  2. Choose New campaign.
  3. Add objective, target audience, dates, and budget.
  4. Upload creatives or paste campaign asset links.
  5. Connect the campaign to lead capture or reporting workflows.
  6. Review spend, leads, conversion rate, and campaign notes.

docs.title: Metrics to explain
docs.text: Metric Meaning Spend Amount used from the campaign budget. Leads Number of contacts captured from the campaign. Cost per lead Spend divided by leads. Conversion rate Leads that became replies, bookings, orders, or customers.

docs.title: Connect a social media account
docs.text: Authorize a brand channel so posts can be drafted, approved, and scheduled from Ohanvi.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• You are signed in as an Ohanvi admin.
  • You have admin access to the social page or channel.
  • Pop-ups are allowed in your browser for the authorization window.

docs.title: Connect the account
docs.text:
1. Open Social from the left navigation.
  2. Select Connected accounts.
  3. Choose the channel you want to connect.
  4. Click Connect.
  5. Sign in to the channel account.
  6. Approve the requested permissions.
  7. Return to Ohanvi after the success message appears.

docs.title: Verify the connection
docs.text:
1. Check that the account status shows Connected.
  2. Confirm the correct page name and profile image appear.
  3. Create a short draft post.
  4. Confirm the connected page appears in the channel picker.

docs.title: Next steps
docs.text:
• Create a post calendar.
  • Invite reviewers for approval.
  • Schedule the first post from the composer.

docs.title: Create a WhatsApp message template
docs.text: Prepare a reusable message that can be approved and used for campaigns, reminders, and automated follow-ups.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• WhatsApp Business account is connected.
  • You know the template purpose: marketing, utility, or authentication.
  • You have sample values for every variable.

docs.title: Write the template
docs.text:
1. Open WhatsApp Marketing.
  2. Select Templates.
  3. Choose Create template.
  4. Enter a short template name, such as festival_offer_2026.
  5. Choose the language and category.
  6. Write the message body in clear customer-facing language.

docs.title: Add variables
docs.text:
Use variables for details that change per customer, such as name, order number, appointment date, or offer code.

Variable Sample value {{1}} Rahul {{2}} OH1234 {{3}} 6 PM today

Example body:

Hello {{1}}, your order {{2}} is ready for pickup. Visit us before {{3}}.

docs.title: Submit for approval
docs.text:
1. Preview the message for spelling and spacing.
  2. Add header, footer, or button content if required.
  3. Click Submit for approval.
  4. Wait for approval status before using the template in broadcasts.

docs.title: Use the approved template
docs.text:
1. Open a broadcast or workflow action.
  2. Select the approved template.
  3. Map variables to contact fields.
  4. Send a test before publishing.

docs.title: Create and send an email campaign
docs.text: Build a campaign, select a segment, test the message, and track opens and clicks.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Open Email Marketing.
  2. Choose New campaign.
  3. Add subject, sender name, preview text, and campaign tags.
  4. Select a template or start with a blank email.
  5. Choose an audience segment and suppression list.
  6. Send a test email.
  7. Review all links and dynamic fields.
  8. Schedule the campaign or send it now.

docs.title: Pre-send checks
docs.text:
• All links open correctly.
  • Unsubscribe footer is present.
  • Sender domain authentication is healthy.
  • Preview text is clear on mobile.
  • The selected audience segment is correct.

docs.title: Embed a video inside a help article
docs.text: Add tutorial videos safely so users can watch directly from the documentation page.

docs.title: YouTube embed
docs.text:
Use the embed URL format, not the normal watch URL. This prevents many player configuration errors.

Use this format:

https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/VIDEO_ID?rel=0

docs.title: Loom or Vimeo
docs.text:
1. Open the video sharing settings.
  2. Enable public or workspace access.
  3. Copy the embed iframe link.
  4. Paste it inside a media-frame block.

docs.title: Generic iframe checklist
docs.text:
• The URL must be an embed URL.
  • The video must allow embedding on external websites.
  • Use HTTPS links only.
  • Keep the iframe inside media-frame so it stays responsive.

docs.title: Fallback link
docs.text: If a video provider blocks embeds, add a normal button link below the video so users can open it in a new tab.

docs.title: Import contacts from a CSV file
docs.text: Add customers or leads into Ohanvi so they can be used in WhatsApp, email, workflow, and ad follow-up campaigns.

docs.title: Goal
docs.text: By the end of this guide, the user has imported a contact list, mapped the important fields, and confirmed which rows were added or skipped.

docs.title: Prepare the CSV file
docs.text:
1. Create one row per contact.
  2. Keep the first row as column names.
  3. Include useful fields such as name, phone, email, city, tags, and opt_in_status.
  4. Format WhatsApp numbers with country code, for example 919876543210.
  5. Export the spreadsheet as a comma-separated CSV file.

docs.title: Upload the file
docs.text:
1. Open CRM from the left navigation.
  2. Select Contacts.
  3. Choose Import.
  4. Drag the CSV file into the upload area or choose it from your computer.
  5. Select whether duplicate contacts should be skipped or updated.
  6. Click Continue.

docs.title: Map and review fields
docs.text:
CSV column Ohanvi field name Full name phone WhatsApp number email Email address tags Contact tags

Screenshot suggestion

Add a screenshot here showing the mapping screen before clicking Import.

docs.title: Fix skipped rows
docs.text: Problem Fix Phone numbers skipped Confirm country codes are present. Duplicates skipped Choose update existing contacts and upload again. Tags missing Check the tag separator format supported by your import screen.

docs.title: Schedule a post across connected channels
docs.text: Prepare content once, preview it per channel, and publish it at the best time.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Open Social Media.
  2. Select Composer.
  3. Choose the channels for publishing.
  4. Add caption, media, hashtags, and tracking links.
  5. Preview each channel.
  6. Resolve validation warnings.
  7. Select Schedule.
  8. Choose the publishing date and time.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• Use UTM links when the post is part of a campaign.
  • Keep channel-specific captions short enough for mobile previews.
  • Add an approval step if customers, compliance, or internal teams need to review posts.

docs.title: Set up a WhatsApp broadcast campaign
docs.text:
Create an approved template, select contacts, schedule the broadcast, and review delivery results.

Sample guide

This page is a documentation sample. Replace labels and screenshots with the exact Ohanvi portal screens.

docs.title: Before you start
docs.text:
• Your WhatsApp Business account is connected to Ohanvi.
  • Your message template is approved by Meta.
  • Your contact list has valid opt-in status.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Open WhatsApp Marketing from the Ohanvi sidebar.
  2. Select Broadcasts, then choose Create broadcast.
  3. Pick an approved template.
  4. Map dynamic fields such as customer name, offer code, appointment date, or order number.
  5. Select a saved audience or upload a CSV contact list.
  6. Review the preview for sample contacts.
  7. Choose Send now or schedule a future date and time.
  8. Publish the broadcast.

Screenshot suggestion

Add one screenshot after the template mapping step and another after the schedule confirmation step.

docs.title: Video walkthrough
docs.text: Use a YouTube embed URL, not a normal watch URL. This avoids common player configuration errors.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Issue Fix Template unavailable Confirm Meta approved it for the connected business number. Contacts skipped Check opt-in status and phone number format. Low delivery Review failed reasons in the delivery report.

docs.title: Build a lead follow-up workflow
docs.text: Trigger automatic WhatsApp, email, or task actions when a lead enters a segment.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Open Workflows.
  2. Select Create workflow.
  3. Choose a trigger such as new lead, form submitted, or tag added.
  4. Add conditions for source, location, score, or campaign.
  5. Add actions such as WhatsApp message, email, sales task, or delay.
  6. Test with a sample contact.
  7. Activate the workflow.

docs.title: Example flow
docs.text: Stage Configuration Trigger Lead created from Facebook Ads Action Send WhatsApp welcome template Delay Wait 1 day Condition If no reply, assign sales follow-up task

docs.title: Common checks
docs.text:
• Make sure the trigger can only fire when expected.
  • Add delays before repeated follow-ups.
  • Test with a sample contact before activating for all leads.
